service_name.jp: 昭和村デマンドタクシー

operating_days.en: Monday to Friday (Closed: Saturdays, Sundays, Public Holidays, and Year-end/New Year holidays Dec 29 – Jan 3)
operating_days.jp: 月〜金 (運休: 土日祝、年末年始 12/29〜1/3)

en: Elementary and Junior High school students
Preschoolers (Free if accompanied by an adult; 100 yen otherwise)
jp: 未就学児 (保護者同伴無料、それ以外100円)
障害者手帳をお持ちの方

note.en: Commuter and student passes are available (refer to website for 1-month and 3-month rates).
note.jp: 定期券（一般・通学）があります（1ヶ月・3ヶ月料金はWebサイト参照）。

note.en: Reservations accepted from 1 week prior until 30 minutes before boarding.
note.jp: 乗車1週間前から30分前まで予約受付。

reservation_window.en: From 1 week in advance until 30 minutes before the scheduled ride

en: Prior user registration at the village office is mandatory.
Ride-sharing is required; arrival times are not guaranteed.
Service is restricted to travel within Showa Village and designated points in Numata City.
jp: 役場での事前利用者登録が必須です。
乗合のため、到着時間は保証されません。
昭和村内および沼田市の指定箇所への移動に限られます。
